parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualityMetricsAggregatorTests.swift`. Despite a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.8636), `tracksInterpolationEnabledPercent` and `countsInterpolationActivations` are distinct test cases exercising different observable behaviours of `QualityMetricsAggregator` — interpolation-enabled percentage tracking versus interpolation activation counting. Near-duplicate test methods are a well-known pattern where shared shape reflects a common arrange-act-assert skeleton, not accidental duplication; collapsing them would obscure the distinct failure signals each test is meant to surface.
